description: This file defines functions and types for managing and displaying channel capabilities in a plugin-based system, including resolving plugin reports, formatting support details, and generating command output.

methods.name: normalizeTimeout
methods.description: Converts raw timeout input to a finite number, falling back to default if invalid.

methods.name: formatSupport
methods.description: Generates a string describing the capabilities supported by a channel plugin.

methods.name: formatGenericProbeLines
methods.description: Formats probe result into display lines.

methods.name: renderDisplayLine
methods.description: Renders a display line with appropriate theme based on tone.

methods.name: resolveChannelReports
methods.description: Resolves and returns reports on channel plugin capabilities for given accounts.

methods.name: channelsCapabilitiesCommand
methods.description: Main command function to gather and display or output channel capabilities information.
